references.label: Top Spin saucer
references.description: The upper saucer sits above the five-bumper nest near the top-center playfield.

references.label: Center Spin saucer
references.description: The center saucer is the main lower entrance into the bumper nest.

references.context: Hit the far-left target beside the center saucer.
references.label: Center-post target
references.description: The far-left standup beside the center saucer raises the center post.

references.label: Center safety post
references.description: The post rises between the two flippers after its standup target is hit.

references.label: Right-outlane mini-post
references.description: The small post sits in the right outlane and offers limited protection.

references.label: West Gate
references.description: The left-side gate opens when awarded by a Spin result.
